name: Install Husky
description: Add Git hooks with Husky to enforce quality checks before every commit.

variables.pr_body:
## Husky Setup

This PR adds [Husky](https://typicode.github.io/husky/) for Git hook management.

### What's included

- **`.husky/pre-commit`** — Pre-commit hook (runs on every commit)
- **`package.json`** — Updated with `prepare` script for automatic setup

### Next steps

1. **Merge this PR**
2. Run `npm install` to activate the hooks
3. Edit `.husky/pre-commit` to add your checks (e.g. `npx lint-staged`)

---

*Installed with [Kerex](https://kerex.app)*
